verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents the payment-routing end of this story. It offers automated invoice payments and approval flows, smart invoice scanning to capture recipient details, and invoice audit trails. Its MCP server also lets AI agents review bill-pay invoices, manage vendors and pay them. However, nothing in the evidence covers matching invoices to purchase orders or automatically coding them to GL accounts or categories; accounting sync is only an export integration. Missing for 10: invoice-to-PO matching, automated GL/expense coding of invoices, detail on how approval routing works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
